title: Inference Error Stratifier and Trace-Binding Catalog for Dashboarding
creator: Anika Sharma
description: Goal: Build a repeatable error stratification catalog and a trace-binding pattern that lets dashboards and alerting reliably attribute user-visible failures to root causes (timeouts, overload, model exceptions, bad input, infra errors, HTTP/gRPC codes, and routing fallbacks). This ticket covers the taxonomy design, trace/span-level binding rules, metric/tag mapping, log enrichment fields, and a Grafana dashboard spec for multi-dimensional error slices. The output will be a canonical mapping we can enforce in the trace-enrichment pipeline and a set of dashboard panels for ops and SREs.
acceptance_criteria:
1) Documented taxonomy that includes canonical labels: timeout, overload, model_error, invalid_input, runtime_oom, network_partition, http_4xx, http_5xx, grpc_status_X, routing_fallback.
2) Trace-binding spec: all model calls must annotate spans with error.signature and error.phase (ingest|routing|model|serve).
3) Metrics produced: error_count{route,model,region,tenant,canonical_reason} and error_latency_histogram.
4) Dashboards: heatmap of canonical_reason by route+model, time-series for P50/P95 error-latency, top10 error signatures table, and SLO breach correlator panel.
5) Dark launch: enrichment enabled for 10% of traffic with no alerts; full rollout when PRD and infra costs approved.
6) Tests: end-to-end synthetic injections for each canonical label with automated assertions in observability-integ CI.
